  &lt;div class="shell"&gt;
    &lt;h1&gt;批量按文件名新建文件夹并整理文件by fy&lt;/h1&gt;
    &lt;div class="sub"&gt; &lt;strong&gt;.bat 批处理脚本&lt;/strong&gt; 默认是“先预览、再输入 Y 确认执行”，&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="notice"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;安全提示：&lt;/strong&gt;浏览器不会直接移动文件。导出的 .bat 运行后会先列出计划，只有输入 Y 才会复制/移动。建议保持 COPY。&lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div class="grid"&gt;
      &lt;section class="card"&gt;
        &lt;h2&gt;1. 选择文件与规则&lt;/h2&gt;
        &lt;div class="body"&gt;
          &lt;label&gt;选择文件（可多选）&lt;input id="fileInput" type="file" multiple /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
          &lt;div class="row"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;分组规则
              &lt;select id="rule"&gt;
                &lt;option value="stem"&gt;每个文件一个同名文件夹&lt;/option&gt;
                &lt;option value="beforeSep"&gt;取分隔符前内容&lt;/option&gt;
                &lt;option value="fixedPrefix"&gt;取前 N 个字符&lt;/option&gt;
                &lt;option value="cleanEpisode"&gt;清理集数/版本后归类&lt;/option&gt;
              &lt;/select&gt;
            &lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;整理动作
              &lt;select id="action"&gt;
                &lt;option value="COPY"&gt;复制文件 COPY（推荐）&lt;/option&gt;
                &lt;option value="MOVE"&gt;移动文件 MOVE&lt;/option&gt;
              &lt;/select&gt;
            &lt;/label&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="row"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;分隔符&lt;input id="separator" value="-" placeholder="例如 - 或 _" /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;前 N 个字符&lt;input id="count" type="number" min="1" value="6" /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="row"&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;源文件夹路径（选文件后自动填为文件所在目录）&lt;input id="sourceDir" value="D:\\待整理文件" /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
            &lt;label&gt;目标文件夹路径（默认桌面新建副本）&lt;input id="targetDir" value="%USERPROFILE%\\Desktop\\整理副本" /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div id="pathNote" class="small"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;label&gt;忽略扩展名（英文逗号分隔）&lt;input id="ignoreExt" value="tmp,log,bak" /&gt;&lt;/label&gt;
          &lt;div class="btns"&gt;
            &lt;button id="previewBtn"&gt;生成预览&lt;/button&gt;
            &lt;button class="warn" id="downloadBatBtn" disabled&gt;下载确认执行版 .bat&lt;/button&gt;
            &lt;button class="secondary" id="downloadCsvBtn" disabled&gt;下载清单 CSV&lt;/button&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="small"&gt;例：&lt;code&gt;客户A-合同-2026.pdf&lt;/code&gt; 用“取分隔符前内容”会进入 &lt;code&gt;客户A&lt;/code&gt; 文件夹。&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/section&gt;

      &lt;section class="card"&gt;
        &lt;h2&gt;2. 预览与导出&lt;/h2&gt;
        &lt;div class="body"&gt;
          &lt;div class="stats"&gt;
            &lt;div class="stat"&gt;&lt;b id="fileCount"&gt;0&lt;/b&gt;&lt;span&gt;文件数&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="stat"&gt;&lt;b id="folderCount"&gt;0&lt;/b&gt;&lt;span&gt;文件夹数&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="stat"&gt;&lt;b id="ignoredCount"&gt;0&lt;/b&gt;&lt;span&gt;忽略文件&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="stat"&gt;&lt;b id="totalSize"&gt;0 B&lt;/b&gt;&lt;span&gt;总大小&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;span class="pill"&gt;导出的 BAT：预览 → 输入 Y → 执行&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;div id="previewArea" class="empty"&gt;选择文件后点击“生成预览”。&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div&gt;
            &lt;div class="small" style="margin-bottom:8px;"&gt;BAT 脚本预览&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div id="scriptPreview" class="code"&gt;暂无。生成预览后可下载完整脚本。&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/section&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;script&gt;
    const $ = (id) =&gt; document.getElementById(id);
    let currentPlan = [];
    let ignored = [];

    function splitName(name) {
      const i = name.lastIndexOf(".");
      if (i &lt;= 0) return { stem: name, ext: "" };
      return { stem: name.slice(0, i), ext: name.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase() };
    }

    function sanitizeFolder(name) {
      let safe = String(name || "unnamed").trim();
      safe = safe.replace(/[&lt;&gt;:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1F]/g, "_");
      safe = safe.replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/[. ]+$/g, "");
      return safe || "unnamed";
    }

    function groupFor(name) {
      const { stem } = splitName(name);
      const rule = $("rule").value;
      const sep = $("separator").value || "-";
      const n = Math.max(1, parseInt($("count").value || "1", 10));
      if (rule === "beforeSep") return sanitizeFolder(stem.includes(sep) ? stem.split(sep)[0] : stem);
      if (rule === "fixedPrefix") return sanitizeFolder(stem.slice(0, n));
      if (rule === "cleanEpisode") {
        const cleaned = stem.replace(/[\[【(（]?(第?\s*\d{1,4}\s*[集话章]|EP?\s*\d{1,4}|S\d{1,2}E\d{1,3}|v\d+|版本\d+)[\]】)）]?/ig, "").replace(/[-_ ]{2,}/g, " ").trim();
        return sanitizeFolder(cleaned || stem);
      }
      return sanitizeFolder(stem);
    }

    function fmtBytes(bytes) {
      const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let n = bytes, i = 0;
      while (n &gt;= 1024 &amp;&amp; i &lt; units.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }
      return `${n.toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;
    }

    function generatePlan() {
      const files = Array.from($("fileInput").files || []);
      const ignore = new Set($("ignoreExt").value.split(",").map(s =&gt; s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^\./, "")).filter(Boolean));
      currentPlan = [];
      ignored = [];
      for (const f of files) {
        const { ext } = splitName(f.name);
        if (ignore.has(ext)) ignored.push({ file: f.name, size: f.size });
        else currentPlan.push({ file: f.name, folder: groupFor(f.name), size: f.size });
      }
      render();
    }

    function render() {
      const folders = new Set(currentPlan.map(x =&gt; x.folder));
      $("fileCount").textContent = currentPlan.length;
      $("folderCount").textContent = folders.size;
      $("ignoredCount").textContent = ignored.length;
      $("totalSize").textContent = fmtBytes(currentPlan.reduce((s, x) =&gt; s + x.size, 0));
      $("downloadBatBtn").disabled = currentPlan.length === 0;
      $("downloadCsvBtn").disabled = currentPlan.length === 0;
      if (!currentPlan.length) {
        $("previewArea").className = "empty";
        $("previewArea").textContent = "没有可整理文件。";
      } else {
        $("previewArea").className = "tablewrap";
        $("previewArea").innerHTML = `&lt;table&gt;&lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;#&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;文件&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;目标文件夹&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;大小&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt;&lt;tbody&gt;${currentPlan.map((x, i) =&gt; `&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;${i + 1}&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;${escapeHtml(x.file)}&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td class="folder"&gt;${escapeHtml(x.folder)}&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;${fmtBytes(x.size)}&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;`).join("")}&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;`;
      }
      $("scriptPreview").textContent = buildBat(true);
    }

    function escapeHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&amp;&lt;&gt;"']/g, c =&gt; ({"&amp;":"&amp;","&lt;":"&lt;","&gt;":"&gt;","\"":""","'":"'"}[c])); }
    function batSafe(s) { return String(s).replace(/"/g, ""); }
    function csvCell(s) { return "\"" + String(s).replace(/"/g, "\"\"") + "\""; }

    function download(name, text, type) {
      const blob = new Blob([text], { type });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = name;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }

    function buildCsv() {
      return "\ufeff" + [["file_name", "target_folder", "size_bytes"].map(csvCell).join(",")].concat(currentPlan.map(x =&gt; [x.file, x.folder, x.size].map(csvCell).join(","))).join("\n");
    }

    function buildBat(short) {
      const sourceDir = batSafe($("sourceDir").value || ".");
      const targetDir = batSafe($("targetDir").value || sourceDir);
      const action = $("action").value === "MOVE" ? "MOVE" : "COPY";
      const planLines = currentPlan.map(x =&gt; `call :Process "${batSafe(x.file)}" "${batSafe(x.folder)}"`).join("\r\n");
      const script = `@echo off\r\nsetlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion\r\nchcp 65001 &gt;nul\r\n\r\nrem Generated by file organizer tool. Preview first, then confirm execution.\r\nrem Type Y only after checking the preview.\r\n\r\nset "SOURCE_DIR=${sourceDir}"\r\nset "TARGET_DIR=${targetDir}"\r\nset "ACTION=${action}"\r\n\r\nif not exist "%SOURCE_DIR%" (\r\n  echo [ERROR] Source folder does not exist: %SOURCE_DIR%\r\n  pause\r\n  exit /b 1\r\n)\r\n\r\necho Source: %SOURCE_DIR%\r\necho Target: %TARGET_DIR%\r\necho Action: %ACTION%\r\necho.\r\necho ===== PREVIEW ONLY: no files will be changed =====\r\ncall :RunPlan 0\r\n\r\necho.\r\necho ===== CONFIRM =====\r\necho Type Y and press Enter to execute. Any other input cancels.\r\nset /p "CONFIRM=Execute now? [Y/N]: "\r\nif /I not "%CONFIRM%"=="Y" (\r\n  echo Cancelled. No files were changed.\r\n  pause\r\n  exit /b 0\r\n)\r\n\r\necho.\r\necho ===== EXECUTING =====\r\ncall :RunPlan 1\r\necho.\r\necho Done.\r\npause\r\nexit /b 0\r\n\r\n:RunPlan\r\nset "EXECUTE=%~1"\r\nset /a TOTAL=0\r\nset /a SKIPPED=0\r\n${planLines}\r\nif "%EXECUTE%"=="1" (\r\n  echo Executed: %TOTAL%, skipped or failed: %SKIPPED%.\r\n) else (\r\n  echo Preview complete. Planned: %TOTAL%, skipped: %SKIPPED%. No files changed.\r\n)\r\nexit /b 0\r\n\r\n:Process\r\nset "FILE_NAME=%~1"\r\nset "FOLDER_NAME=%~2"\r\nset "SRC=%SOURCE_DIR%\\%FILE_NAME%"\r\nset "DEST_DIR=%TARGET_DIR%\\%FOLDER_NAME%"\r\ncall :UniquePath "%DEST_DIR%" "%FILE_NAME%" DEST_FILE\r\n\r\nif not exist "%SRC%" (\r\n  echo [SKIP] Source missing: %SRC%\r\n  set /a SKIPPED+=1\r\n  exit /b 0\r\n)\r\n\r\nif "%EXECUTE%"=="1" (\r\n  if not exist "%DEST_DIR%" mkdir "%DEST_DIR%"\r\n  if /I "%ACTION%"=="MOVE" (\r\n    move /Y "%SRC%" "%DEST_FILE%" &gt;nul\r\n  ) else (\r\n    copy /Y "%SRC%" "%DEST_FILE%" &gt;nul\r\n  )\r\n  if errorlevel 1 (\r\n    echo [FAIL] "%SRC%"\r\n    set /a SKIPPED+=1\r\n  ) else (\r\n    echo [OK] "%SRC%" --^&gt; "%DEST_FILE%"\r\n    set /a TOTAL+=1\r\n  )\r\n) else (\r\n  echo [PLAN] "%SRC%" --^&gt; "%DEST_FILE%"\r\n  set /a TOTAL+=1\r\n)\r\nexit /b 0\r\n\r\n:UniquePath\r\nset "UDIR=%~1"\r\nset "UFULL=%~2"\r\nset "UBASE=%~n2"\r\nset "UEXT=%~x2"\r\nset "OUT=%UDIR%\\%UFULL%"\r\nset /a N=1\r\n:UniqueLoop\r\nif exist "%OUT%" (\r\n  set "OUT=%UDIR%\\%UBASE% (!N!)%UEXT%"\r\n  set /a N+=1\r\n  goto :UniqueLoop\r\n)\r\nset "%~3=%OUT%"\r\nexit /b 0\r\n`;
      if (short &amp;&amp; script.length &gt; 4000) return script.slice(0, 4000) + "\r\n...\r\nrem Preview truncated. Download to get the full script.";
      return script;
    }

    function showPathNote(text) { $("pathNote").textContent = text; }

    function applySelectionDefaults() {
      const files = Array.from($("fileInput").files || []);
      if (!files.length) return;
      const first = files[0];
      const raw = first.path || first.webkitRelativePath;
      if (raw &amp;&amp; typeof raw === "string") {
        const norm = raw.replace(/\//g, "\\");
        const idx = norm.lastIndexOf("\\");
        if (idx &gt; 0) {
          const dir = norm.slice(0, idx);
          const srcBase = dir.split("\\").pop() || "待整理文件";
          $("sourceDir").value = dir;
          $("targetDir").value = "%USERPROFILE%\\Desktop\\" + srcBase + "_副本";
          showPathNote("已根据所选文件自动填充：源=" + dir + "，目标=桌面\\" + srcBase + "_副本");
          generatePlan();
          return;
        }
      }
      if (!$("sourceDir").value) $("sourceDir").value = "D:\\待整理文件";
      if ($("targetDir").value === "D:\\organized_files" || !$("targetDir").value) $("targetDir").value = "%USERPROFILE%\\Desktop\\整理副本";
      showPathNote("当前环境无法读取文件绝对路径，请在下载 BAT 前手动确认“源文件夹路径”。");
    }

    $("fileInput").addEventListener("change", applySelectionDefaults);
    $("previewBtn").addEventListener("click", generatePlan);
    $("downloadBatBtn").addEventListener("click", () =&gt; download("organize_generated_confirm.bat", buildBat(false), "application/x-bat;charset=utf-8"));
    $("downloadCsvBtn").addEventListener("click", () =&gt; download("file_organize_plan.csv", buildCsv(), "text/csv;charset=utf-8"));
    ["rule", "action", "separator", "count", "sourceDir", "targetDir", "ignoreExt"].forEach(id =&gt; $(id).addEventListener("input", () =&gt; { if (($("fileInput").files || []).length) generatePlan(); }));
  &lt;/script&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;
</pre></div><br>
<br>

</td></tr></tbody></table>
